svg.title: Munich, 1938
svg.desc: Situation map covering 11.3°E to 27.4°E, 47.0°N to 51.6°N. The ground Czechoslovakia ceded in the autumn of 1938, before the Vienna Award. Change in ground held by Czechoslovakia, September 1938 to October 1938: held throughout 78%, lost 22%. Both extents are OpenHistoricalMap relations, taken by one script from one source under one tagging scheme, so the difference between them is the change it records and not a change of method. Crowd-sourced: the border precision varies along its length. Present-day frontiers are not drawn: on a plate of a past year they would be a different claim. OpenHistoricalMap relations 2692764 and 2747874 (CC0); Natural Earth basemap. Before 30 September and after 10 October 1938. 2 mapped features can be reached with the Tab key, each one naming what it is.

path.aria-label: Held throughout by Czechoslovakia: held in September 1938 and in October 1938

g.text: held in September 1938 and in October

path.aria-label: Lost by Czechoslovakia: held in September 1938, not in October 1938

g.text: held in September 1938, not in October

g.aria-label: Note 1. The Sudetenland and its border forts, occupied by Germany, 1–10 October.
g.title: The Sudetenland and its border forts, occupied by Germany, 1–10 October.

g.aria-label: Note 2. Still Czechoslovak here: the Vienna Award gave southern Slovakia to Hungary on 2 November.
g.title: Still Czechoslovak here: the Vienna Award gave southern Slovakia to Hungary on 2 November.

g.aria-label: Note 3. What was left of Bohemia and Moravia was occupied in March 1939.
g.title: What was left of Bohemia and Moravia was occupied in March 1939.

g.text: and Moravia was occupied in March
